svg.desc: Scatter of 113 results: pass@1 on the vertical axis, avg cost per task on the horizontal from highest at left to lowest at right; each model’s effort levels are joined in order from low to max.
svg.text: DeepSWE 1.1 score against cost per task
Lines join each model’s effort levels from low to max, as on the official board. Colour is the lab; shape is who measured it.
